Three ways it answers.

Your assistant

Their price, shown first

People together

Shared, on one receipt

One loop under every request.

Six steps, the same for every person, company and assistant. Nothing is a special case.

  1. Event

    Something happened: a message, a delivery on a channel, a schedule, a read from a connected tool.

    "I need a scooter by 3 pm."

  2. Fact

    What is known, with its source, who may see it, how long it holds and who consented. A change is a new row; the past stays.

    Wants a scooter in Canggu, today.

  3. Goal

    What a person or a company wants: a kind, a window, a place band, a budget band and a result that can be checked.

    A scooter, under 100k, before 3 pm.

  4. Plan and route

    Steps, and for each step a route: a model, a connected tool, the browser, a person inside the organisation, a person outside, a partner, or a call you consented to.

    Ask three shops; one person delivers.

  5. Proposal

    The one unit of action, between people and assistants alike. It is approved, run automatically under a policy you can read, or refused.

    "Made can bring it for 80k. Accept?"

  6. Receipt

    The verified outcome, and the only measure of success: what was asked, who did it, what it cost. It is what a profile shows.

    Scooter, 1 day, 80,000, deposit held.

Questions.

What does it cost?

Your assistant is free. You pay only when a real person does a job for you, at the price you saw before saying yes. Our fee is a separate visible line, never hidden in a model price.

Who are the people it finds?

Verified providers, nearby when the job is physical, licensed when the law requires it. Their completed jobs are counted from receipts, not from star ratings.

Can I run it myself?

Yes. The community edition runs on your own machine with your own model keys. The hosted version adds the people, the payments and the receipts.

What do you see about me?

Your conversations, your facts and your money stay in your room under your rules. Nothing is shown to others unless you set it to be.

When?

Soon. Join the waiting list and you will be first to try it, free.
